title: Computability of $\mathcal{G}$-Beroulli Measures and Measures of Maximal Entropy on Coded Shift Spaces
summary: In this paper, we investigate the computability of $\mathcal{G}$-Bernoulli measures, with a particular focus on measures of maximal entropy (MMEs) on coded shift spaces. Coded shifts are natural generalizations of sofic shifts and are defined as the closure of all bi-infinite concatenations of words (generators) drawn from a countable generating set $\mathcal{G}$. We begin by establishing a computability criterion for $\mathcal{G}$-Bernoulli measures which are invariant measures given by assigning probability weights to the generators.
